gen-gf-baumans-gf-ar-one-sans: Ruler-straight and unmistakable, Baumans draws its crescent-wrench c at a constant line width. AR One Sans sits below as a modern sans-serif counterpart, its brush-like ends lifting away before each curve closes.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-assistant: A c like an opened crescent wrench marks Baumans, whose lowercase a has no thin hairlines. Baumans makes the statement, while Assistant does the quiet work, its letter mouths staying open.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-asta-sans: Baumans has a c shaped like an opened crescent wrench. What links them is line: Asta Sans draws tubelike, constant-weight strokes, with e shapes never mistaken for a blot, just as Baumans does.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-bai-jamjuree: Blunt and unmistakable, Baumans has a c like an opened crescent wrench and strokes that never thicken or thin. Bai Jamjuree reads light and unpinched from line to line.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-barlow: Distinctive at a glance, Baumans has a crescent-wrench c and strokes of constant width. And Barlow keeps whole paragraphs approachable, its neon-tube strokes and well-parted c tips easy on the eye.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic is modern and professional, with a wide channel leading into every bowl. BIZ UDGothic sits quietly under Baumans, whose pen-plotter smoothness comes from its lines of constant width.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-biz-udpgothic: Generous spacing and a clear channel into each round letter make the body approachable. BIZ UDPGothic does the patient reading, while Baumans, with no pointed-brush swell, plays the commanding part.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-bpmf-huninn: Blunt and unforgettable, Baumans pairs a crescent-wrench c with strokes of constant width. Bpmf Huninn is the sans-serif that matches it, its single-weight outline feel echoing that constant line.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: A crescent-wrench c and bold, unswelling strokes mark Baumans out at once. And Bpmf Zihi Kai Std adds a faint but real thick-thin shift, with counters that stay connected to the outside.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-cairo: Baumans draws a crescent-wrench c in a single-weight outline feel. Cairo, a modern sans-serif with a wide channel into every bowl, should carry a full page of text without tiring the eye.
